name: Shallum
title: Israel's Brief Reigning King
summary: Shallum was the son of Jabesh and became Israel's sixteenth king. He murdered King Zechariah and seized the throne, but reigned for only one month before being killed by Menahem, who then became king.

keyEvents.title: Kills King Zechariah
keyEvents.description: Shallum conspired against King Zechariah and killed him publicly in Jibleam, then took the throne of Israel himself.

keyEvents.title: Becomes King of Israel
keyEvents.description: Shallum became king over Israel in Samaria during the thirtieth year of King Uzziah's reign in Judah.

keyEvents.title: Reigns for Only One Month
keyEvents.description: His reign was extremely short—just one month—making him one of the most short-lived kings in Israel's history.

keyEvents.title: Killed by Menahem
keyEvents.description: Menahem, son of Gadi, marched up from Tirzah to Samaria, struck Shallum down and took the throne from him.

keyEvents.title: Fulfillment of Prophecy
keyEvents.description: Shallum's brief reign and violent death were part of the fulfillment of the Lord's word to Jehu that his descendants would sit on Israel's throne for four generations.
